name: Trader Joe's Dumpling Bake
desc: Frozen Trader Joe's dumplings baked under foil in a coconut cream, red curry and Soyaki sauce.

source.title: Trader Joe's Dumpling Bake
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/2 (11 oz) bottle Trader Joe's Thai Red Curry Sauce
ingredients.item: Trader Joe's Thai Red Curry Sauce

ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz) bag frozen Trader Joe's dumplings (such as chicken gyoza)
1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice, steamed, for serving

steps: In an 8x8 in or similar 2-quart baking dish, whisk the coconut cream, Soyaki, red curry sauce, garlic and sesame oil until smooth.
Arrange the frozen dumplings in a single layer in the sauce and spoon some sauce over each.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 30-35 minutes, until the sauce is bubbling and a dumpling cut open is steaming hot in the center (165°F).
Top with chili oil, green onions and black sesame seeds, and serve over steamed rice.
tips: Cover with foil from the start; the creator forgot until halfway and the exposed tops dried out.
Lovely Delites bakes the same combination covered at 350°F for 35-40 minutes if you prefer a gentler bake.

references.title: Viral Trader Joe's Dumpling Bake
